extras.quota_verbatim: 50 GB per transfer, all files combined, no account required. Hosted in Infomaniak's own Swiss datacentres. One notable global property: the source is open (Infomaniak android/iOS/multiplatform clients on GitHub) and there is a working CLI.
extras.limits_verbatim: per-object-cap: 50 GB per transfer (combined, not per file). Retention: 15 days by default; 30 only if the SENDER accepts an extension email on day 12 (offer open 3 days). After expiry Infomaniak states a link cannot be reactivated or extended. pull-count: download cap selectable at 1/20/100/250 — 'unlimited' requires a paid plan. Request-rate: the container-create endpoint enforces a reCAPTCHA field (see reliability note).
extras.egress_verbatim: unmetered, no egress pricing published; direct download links plus a 'Download All' ZIP (ZIP is capped — above 10 GB you must fetch files one by one).
extras.chaining_verbatim: Per-transfer 50 GB x unlimited transfers. With swissfer this is scriptable, so capacity is bounded by how many 50 GB transfers you are willing to mint, each living 15-30 days.
extras.tooling_verbatim: swissfer (github.com/Blutsh/swissfer, 44 stars, pushed 2026-10-21) — Rust CLI, upload AND download, email-confirmed sender. First upload requires a 6-character code emailed to you, then cached. Upstream `send`-style clients do not work.
extras.agent_focus: transfer services repurposed as storage — per-transfer caps, link persistence, plain-GET retrievability, and whether 'transfer' becomes 'store'

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
